extraction_query: SELECT strategy_version, count(*) AS settled_trades, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r_multiple > 0) AS wins, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r_multiple < 0) AS losses, avg(r_multiple) AS avg_r, CASE WHEN sum(CASE WHEN r_multiple < 0 THEN abs(r_multiple) ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE sum(CASE WHEN r_multiple > 0 THEN r_multiple ELSE 0 END) / sum(CASE WHEN r_multiple < 0 THEN abs(r_multiple) ELSE 0 END) END AS profit_factor, sum(net_pnl_usdt) AS net_pnl_usdt, min(entry_time) AS first_entry_time, max(entry_time) AS last_entry_time FROM public.bca_shadow_paper_trades WHERE strategy_version IN ('default-trend-shadow-v1','trend-rejection-shadow-v1') AND exit_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY strategy_version ORDER BY strategy_version;
methodology: Read-only aggregate query against public.bca_shadow_paper_trades using settled rows only (exit_time IS NOT NULL). Shadow metrics are supporting evidence only; they do not replace immutable historical OOS or frozen holdout evidence, lower any Promotion Gate, or grant Production Email eligibility.
